visualCharacteristics.purpose: Grid of padded profile cards with inset portrait, location eyebrow, name, bio and arrow link (3-up)
visualCharacteristics.description: Padded white card with inset portrait image (4:3), small uppercase location eyebrow, serif name, short bio and small uppercase arrow link; 3-up.

contentPattern.description: Repeating look-alike profile items (image, place, name, bio, CTA) that flow in a grid: Cards.

usage: Curator/advisor profile grid ("The Architects of Your Journey").
reuseGuidance: Use for people or profile items with a framed card and CTA. Frameless destination tiles use cards-landscape.

cells: Eyebrow paragraph (place/country), H3 title, description paragraph, optional CTA link
withImages.notes: cards-profile CTA 'Meet Jim ->' etc. (no href in source). cards-landscape: Amalfi Coast item links to /destinations/amalfi-coast (link on title); others unlinked.
